summary: This Form 6-K reports the results of Azul S.A.'s annual general meeting held on April 30, 2026. Shareholders approved the company's fiscal 2025 accounts, absorption of net income by accumulated losses, and management compensation for fiscal 2026. A request to install a fiscal council was made but not completed due to lack of proposed members. No special situation event (merger, tender, spin-off, activist campaign, restructuring, etc.) occurred; it is a routine meeting outcome notification.
